info.title: CIA Internal API
info.description: Internal REST API for the Core Insurance Application (staff and system use)

tags.name: Setup — Commission Setups
tags.description: Per-product commission rules. Multiple rules per product (e.g. broker tier × class). Drives commission credit-note generation at policy approval.

tags.name: Partner App Management
tags.description: Internal: manage Insurtech partner app registrations

tags.name: Audit Alerts
tags.description: Real-time anomaly alerts — failed logins, bulk deletes, off-hours activity, large approvals

tags.name: Setup — Quote Config
tags.description: Per-tenant quote-engine configuration: singleton config (validity period, premium calculation sequence LOADING_FIRST vs DISCOUNT_FIRST) + CRUD on discount-type and loading-type master data. Drives Module 2 quote premium calculation.

tags.name: Setup — Vehicle Models
tags.description: Vehicle model master data, scoped under a make (e.g. Toyota → Camry / Corolla / RAV4). Nested resource under /vehicle-makes/{makeId}/models.

tags.name: PAA — Period Close Orchestrator
tags.description: IFRS 17 PAA Slice 2.5 orchestrator. Runs LRC + LIC engines for a period and returns the IFRS 17 §83/§84 Insurance Service Result alongside the engine outputs. Companion read endpoint recomputes §83/§84 from the current paa_lrc + paa_lic state without invoking engines.

tags.name: Claim Comments
tags.description: Append-only comment feed on a claim. Comments are an aggregate of the parent Claim; deletion is not supported (audit-grade history).

tags.name: Setup — Agents
tags.description: NAICOM-licensed insurance agent master data. Agents represent the INSURER and earn commission on policies sold, distinct from Brokers (who represent the INSURED) and from Relationship Managers (internal staff).

tags.name: PAA — Liability for Incurred Claims (LIC)
tags.description: IFRS 17 PAA Slice 2.4 — claim roll-forward via SQL conditional-sum query. Posts paa_lic disclosure rows; v1 posts no JE (underlying GL already correct via SubledgerPostingService).

tags.name: Quotes (Module 2)
tags.description: Quote lifecycle — DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED → CONVERTED (when bound to a policy). Premium calculation supports per-item loadings/discounts + quote-level loadings/discounts; sequence is tenant-configurable (LOADING_FIRST / DISCOUNT_FIRST). Multi-risk and single-risk quotes use the same endpoint surface; the structure of risks differentiates them.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregated KPIs for the back-office home screen

tags.name: Payments (Module 8)
tags.description: Outbound payments against a credit note (claim DV, FAC outward, commission, etc.). Posting a payment subtracts from CN outstanding_amount; full settlement flips the CN to SETTLED. Reversal undoes the payment and posts a contra JE via SubledgerPostingService.

tags.name: Setup — Claim Document Requirements
tags.description: Per-product mandatory documents at claim registration. Drives the required-documents checklist on the claim summary (Module 5).

tags.name: NAICOM Submissions
tags.description: Monthly recap submissions to NAICOM (N01–N08). Period must be HARD_CLOSED before generation. Submissions follow a DRAFT → SUBMITTED → ACKNOWLEDGED → ARCHIVED state machine with a RETRACTED branch from SUBMITTED. All state transitions append-only via naicom_submission_event (Type-2 SCD).

tags.name: Setup — Classes of Business
tags.description: Class of business taxonomy (Motor, Fire, Marine, Aviation, GIT, ...). Drives product setup, IFRS 17 contract grouping (§22), and NAICOM bordereaux classification.

tags.name: PAA — Discount Unwind (§87-92)
tags.description: IFRS 17 PAA Slice 2.6 — discount unwind on paa_lic rows. P&L vs OCI routing per paa_config.oci_election (§88(b)). Posts Dr 5520 / Cr 2140 (P&L) or Dr 3430 / Cr 2140 (OCI). No-op for tenants where paa_config.discount_lic = FALSE.

tags.name: Customers (Module 7)
tags.description: Customer onboarding (individual + corporate) with embedded KYC. Customer number format is per-tenant (CUST/2026/IND/00000001 by default); collision-safe via PESSIMISTIC_WRITE lock in CustomerNumberFormatService. Multipart uploads carry ID document + (for corporate) CAC certificate + director IDs. KYC re-triggers automatically on relevant field updates.

tags.name: PAA — §103 Movement Analysis
tags.description: IFRS 17 §103 disclosure relay (Slice 2.8). Reads from V38 paa_movement_analysis SQL view — LRC totals, LIC totals, per-(portfolio × cohort × onerousness) breakdown. Read-only; consumed by Phase 4 Ifrs17DisclosureEngine.

tags.name: Audit Configuration
tags.description: Alert thresholds and data retention settings — System Admin only for writes

tags.name: IFRS 9 — Premium Receivable ECL (§5.5.15)
tags.description: Slice 3.6 simplified-approach engine. Admin supplies aging-bucket provision matrix [(label, outstandingAmount, defaultRate)]; engine computes lifetime ECL = Σ(outstanding × rate) and posts the delta vs cumulative prior allowance. Posts Dr 5350 PREMIUM_ECL_EXPENSE / Cr 1340 PREMIUM_ECL_ALLOWANCE (increase) or reverse (release). Provision matrix is embedded in JE narrative as §B5.5.36 disclosure substrate.

tags.name: Setup — Survey Thresholds
tags.description: Per-product survey-mandatory thresholds. Multiple rules per product (e.g. SI band × survey type — pre-loss / loss inspection). Drives the survey workflow gating in Module 3 and Module 5.

tags.name: Setup — SBUs (Strategic Business Units)
tags.description: Internal SBU master data. Used for portfolio segmentation in reports and per-SBU approval tiers.

tags.name: IFRS 9 — Amortised Cost (§5.4.1)
tags.description: Slice 3.3 effective interest method. Posts Dr 1250 INVESTMENT_AT_AMORTISED_COST / Cr 4210 INTEREST_INCOME_AC for accruals + additional Dr 1230 / Cr 1250 net-down lines on coupon receipts. Idempotency triple: (IFRS9_AMORTISED_COST, INTEREST_ACCRUAL, holdingId+periodId).

tags.name: Policies (Module 3)
tags.description: Policy lifecycle — DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL → ACTIVE → CANCELLED / EXPIRED. Policies can be bound from an approved quote or created directly. Approval fires POLICY_APPROVED event → SubledgerPostingService → DebitNote + JE; NAICOM/NIID upload child workflows kick off asynchronously.

tags.name: Credit Notes (Module 8)
tags.description: Payables-side documents. Generated automatically when a claim DV is approved, a FAC outward is confirmed, or commission/RI commission becomes payable (SubledgerPostingService listens for ClaimApproved / FacPremiumCeded events). State machine: ISSUED → PARTIALLY_PAID → SETTLED → CANCELLED.

tags.name: IFRS 9 — Investment Holdings
tags.description: Slice 3.2 — register investment holdings under §4.1 classification (SPPI test + business model → FVPL / FVOCI_DEBT / FVOCI_EQUITY / AMORTISED_COST). Reclassification follows §B4.1.26 (rare, audited via Type-2 SCD investment_classification_history).

tags.name: GL Backfill (Admin)
tags.description: Retroactive journal-entry backfill (Slice 1.8). One-time mechanism for moving from "no GL history" to "all GL history reconstructed" — walks every relevant sub-ledger source table and posts the JEs SubledgerPostingService would have written. Idempotent via the JE-gateway triple. See operations/period-end-closures-backfill.md runbook.

tags.name: Setup — Causes of Loss
tags.description: Per-nature-of-loss cause taxonomy. Hierarchy: Nature → Cause. Drives claim registration dropdowns.

tags.name: Customer Documents
tags.description: Per-customer document attachments (KYC certificates, board resolutions, additional ID copies). Distinct from the multipart ID document captured at onboarding — those live on the customer/director records directly.

tags.name: Audit Export
tags.description: Export audit logs as CSV with optional filters

tags.name: Reinsurance Allocations
tags.description: Per-policy treaty allocation. Surplus: retain ≤ Retention Limit, cede to surplus up to Surplus Limit, excess tagged if beyond gross capacity. QS: split by fixed share %. XOL: retain first layer, cede above retention. State machine: AUTO_ALLOCATED → CONFIRMED → APPROVED, or CANCELLED. Allocation lines record per-participant ceded amount + commission.

tags.name: PAA — Onerous Contract Test (§47-49)
tags.description: IFRS 17 PAA Slice 2.7 — cumulative-state target reconciliation. Posts loss-component increase (Dr 5150 / Cr 2130) or reversal JEs as needed. Naturally idempotent — re-runs with no underlying movement produce a no-op result.

tags.name: Trial Balance
tags.description: Cumulative-since-inception trial balance at a given business date. Used by NAICOM's PrudentialReturnEngine (N03) and BalanceSheetEngine (N02), and by the Slice 1.9 reconciliation gate as the source-of-truth balance sheet aggregator.

tags.name: Audit Reports
tags.description: Six pre-built compliance reports — user activity, module actions, approvals, data changes, login security, and ranked user summary

tags.name: Setup — Claim Reserve Categories
tags.description: Reserve bucket master data (e.g. Indemnity, Legal, Expenses). Drives the per-claim reserves on Module 5.

tags.name: Setup — Approval Groups
tags.description: Per-entity-type approval hierarchies. Single-level: one approver within amount range. Multi-level: escalates until an approver whose limit covers the transaction. Drives the approval workflows for Quote / Policy / Endorsement / Claim / Finance.

tags.name: Setup — Password Policy
tags.description: Per-tenant password-policy bookkeeping. Storage-only — actual login-time enforcement is owned by Keycloak's realm policy. The Setup → Password Policy page reads/writes this.

tags.name: Reinsurance Treaties
tags.description: Treaty setup — Surplus / Quota Share / XOL. State machine: DRAFT → ACTIVE → EXPIRED → CANCELLED. Treaty year = policy start date year (not policy creation year). Each treaty has a participant list (reinsurance companies with their share percentages); lead reinsurer drives offer/acceptance.

tags.name: Claim Expenses
tags.description: Per-claim expenses (surveyor fees, repair costs, legal fees, etc). State machine: PENDING → APPROVED → (cascade to a CreditNote via CLAIM_EXPENSE_APPROVED event) or CANCELLED. The approval is what triggers GL impact via SubledgerPostingService.

tags.name: IFRS 9 — §B5.5.39 Movement Analysis
tags.description: Slice 3.7 disclosure relay. Composes investment roll-forward from V40 ifrs9_investment_movement_analysis SQL view + premium-receivable ECL aggregate from JE narrative on account 1340. Read-only; consumed by Phase 4 Ifrs9DisclosureEngine.

tags.name: Setup — Users
tags.description: System user management (Module 1). Users live in Keycloak; this controller is a thin proxy over the Keycloak admin client. Access group assignment is stored as a Keycloak user attribute (accessGroupId).

tags.name: PAA — Liability for Remaining Coverage (LRC)
tags.description: IFRS 17 PAA Slice 2.3 — straight-line daily premium recognition (Dr 2110 / Cr 4110 via JE gateway). Posts paa_lrc rows + JEs.

tags.name: Setup — Vehicle Types
tags.description: Vehicle category master data (Saloon, SUV, Truck, Tricycle, ...). Drives motor-policy classification and rating tables.

tags.name: Journal Entries
tags.description: The Slice 1.4 GL gateway. Every JE in the system passes through JournalEntryService — subledger posting, IFRS 17 PAA engines, IFRS 9 measurement engines, NAICOM source data, manual posts. Idempotency triple: (source_module, source_event_type, source_reference).

tags.name: IFRS 9 — Fair Value (§5.7)
tags.description: Slice 3.4 fair-value remeasurement with classification-driven routing. FVPL → P&L (Dr 4250 / Cr 5330); FVOCI_DEBT → OCI reserve (Dr/Cr 3410); FVOCI_EQUITY → OCI reserve (Dr/Cr 3420). AC holdings refuse remeasurement. Idempotent via closing_fair_value IS NULL sentinel.

tags.name: Setup — Access Groups
tags.description: RBAC access group master data. Each group aggregates module-level permissions ({module}:create / view / update / approve). Users inherit permissions through their assigned access group.

tags.name: Endorsements (Module 4)
tags.description: Mid-term policy changes — Renewal, Extension, Cancellation, Reversal, Reduction in Period, Change in Period, Increase/Decrease SI, Add/Delete Items. Pro-rata premium adjustment: (Annual Premium / 365) × Days. Approval fires ENDORSEMENT_APPROVED event → SubledgerPostingService cascades a DebitNote (additional premium) or CreditNote (return premium) + JE.

tags.name: Claims (Module 5)
tags.description: Full claims lifecycle — registration → processing (reserves + surveyor + inspection) → submission → approval / rejection / withdrawal → DV generation → DV execution → settlement. CLAIM_APPROVED and CLAIM_SETTLED events drive SubledgerPostingService cascades (CreditNote + JE).

tags.name: Setup — Policy Specification
tags.description: Per-product singleton config — controls the policy document template (clause bank, layout, signatures).

tags.name: Setup — Currencies
tags.description: Currency master data (ISO 4217). Drives the currency selector across quotes/policies/finance. NGN is the launch currency; multi-currency is an open question (PRD #5).

tags.name: Setup — Natures of Loss
tags.description: Top-level loss taxonomy. Parent of cause-of-loss. Drives claim registration dropdowns.

tags.name: Reports & Analytics
tags.description: 55 pre-built reports, custom report builder, CSV/PDF export, pin management, access control

tags.name: Setup — Policy Number Format
tags.description: Per-product singleton config — controls how policy numbers are generated (prefix, year placement, sequence length, etc).

tags.name: Setup — Relationship Managers
tags.description: Per-branch relationship-manager master data. RMs are assigned to customers / policies for accountability + portfolio reporting.

tags.name: Setup — Company Settings
tags.description: Per-tenant singleton company profile + password policy + branding. The Setup landing page reads this.

tags.name: Setup — Vehicle Makes
tags.description: Vehicle manufacturer master data (Toyota, Honda, ...). Parent of vehicle-models. Drives motor-policy risk forms.

tags.name: Period Locks
tags.description: Period-lock lifecycle: SOFT_CLOSED (with 5-business-day grace window) → HARD_CLOSED → REOPENED. Hibernate PeriodLockInterceptor enforces locks at every write to LockableByPeriod entities — see Slice 1.7. Locked-period writes throw HTTP 423 LOCKED with structured meta.

tags.name: Posting Rules
tags.description: Read-only access to the sub-ledger → journal-entry posting rules used by SubledgerPostingService. Seeded by V33 (6 rules); SYSTEM rows are immutable until the post-Phase-7 tenant-customisation epic. Compound multi-line events (FAC_PREMIUM_CEDED) are hard-coded in the service and intentionally absent here.

tags.name: Setup — Brokers
tags.description: Broker master data (Module 1). Soft-deleted; preserved for historical policy / commission references.

tags.name: Chart of Accounts
tags.description: Read-only access to the per-tenant Chart of Accounts. The COA is seeded by Flyway (V32 — 129 rows, 3-level hierarchy, IFRS-17 + IFRS-9 + NAICOM role tags). CRUD is deferred until the post-Phase-7 tenant-customisation epic.

tags.name: Setup — Customer Number Format
tags.description: Per-tenant singleton config — controls customer number generation (prefix, year, type-segment, sequence length). Format: {prefix}/{year}/{type}/{sequence} (e.g. CUST/2026/IND/00000001). Lookup via PESSIMISTIC_WRITE in CustomerNumberFormatService — prevents duplicate numbers under concurrent onboarding.

tags.name: IFRS 9 — Investment ECL (§5.5)
tags.description: Slice 3.5 Expected Credit Loss with three-stage routing. AC holdings: ECL reduces asset directly (Dr 5310 ECL_EXPENSE_AC / Cr 1140 ECL_AC_ALLOWANCE). FVOCI_DEBT: ECL routes to OCI reserve (Dr 5310 / Cr 3410) while carrying value stays at fair value — §5.7.10A rule. FVPL: no ECL.

tags.name: Claim Documents
tags.description: Document attachments on a claim. Files are uploaded multipart, streamed via DocumentStorageService, and tagged with ClaimDocumentType (e.g. INCIDENT_REPORT, POLICE_REPORT, REPAIR_QUOTE). Used by the required-documents tracker on the claim summary.

tags.name: Facultative Reinsurance Covers
tags.description: Facultative (FAC) outward covers — for risks that exceed treaty gross capacity or aren't covered by treaty. State machine: DRAFT → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED. Confirmation triggers FAC_PREMIUM_CEDED event → SubledgerPostingService cascades a CreditNote (payable to reinsurer) + JE.

tags.name: Setup — Insurance Companies
tags.description: Co-insurance partner master data (used by Direct-with-Coinsurance + Inward-Coinsurance policy business types).

tags.name: Setup — Products
tags.description: Product master data (single-risk + multi-risk). Drives quote/policy creation across the lifecycle. Each product can have child commission setups, claim document requirements, claim notification timelines, policy number formats, policy specifications, survey thresholds (see nested endpoints).

tags.name: Setup — Reinsurance Companies
tags.description: Reinsurer master data. Drives treaty participant lists and FAC cover counterparties (Module 6).

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Search and view the full system audit trail across all modules

tags.name: Setup — Banks
tags.description: Bank master data. Drives the bank selector on Receipt + Payment processing (Module 8).

tags.name: Setup — Branches
tags.description: Insurer branch master data. Soft-deleted; preserved for historical policy + relationship-manager references.

tags.name: Debit Notes (Module 8)
tags.description: Receivables-side documents. Generated automatically when a policy or endorsement is approved (SubledgerPostingService listens for PolicyApproved / EndorsementApproved events). State machine: ISSUED → PARTIALLY_PAID → SETTLED → CANCELLED / VOID.

tags.name: PAA — Contract Groups
tags.description: IFRS 17 §16-22 contract groups + portfolios. Read-only — writes are event-driven via Slice 2.2's ContractGroupingService (PolicyApprovedEvent listener). The (portfolio, cohort_year, onerousness) triple is permanent per §22.

tags.name: Document Templates
tags.description: PDF template master data for policy / quote / endorsement / DV documents. Per-product or per-class-of-business scoping. Rendered server-side via Thymeleaf + Apache PDFBox at document generation time.

tags.name: Setup — Claim Notification Timeline
tags.description: Per-product singleton config — the SLA / timeline windows within which a claim must be notified after the loss event.

tags.name: Login & Session Logs
tags.description: Login, logout, and failed authentication event recording and retrieval

tags.name: Fiscal Years
tags.description: Fiscal-year lifecycle and the period tree under each year. State machine: DRAFT → ACTIVE → CLOSED. Creating a fiscal year auto-generates MONTH / QUARTER / HALF_YEAR / YEAR periods (19 rows) via FiscalYearService — see Slice 1.6.

tags.name: Receipts (Module 8)
tags.description: Customer receipts against a debit note. Posting a receipt subtracts from outstanding_amount; full settlement flips the debit note status to SETTLED. Reversal undoes the payment (re-opens the DN) and posts a contra entry via SubledgerPostingService.

tags.name: Setup — Adjusters
tags.description: NAICOM-licensed loss-adjuster master data. Distinct from surveyors (pre-loss inspections); adjusters perform post-loss claim assessment.

tags.name: Setup — Surveyors
tags.description: Internal + external surveyor master data. Drives surveyor assignment on pre-loss surveys (Module 3) and post-loss claim inspections (Module 5).

get.summary: Get vehicle model by id (scoped to its make)

put.description: Email is immutable on update — Keycloak treats it as the effective username and rotating it would invalidate existing JWTs. Status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE) and access group reassignment are honoured.
Changes the premium calculation sequence (LOADING_FIRST | DISCOUNT_FIRST) and validity period. Affects ALL subsequent quote creations — existing quotes lock in the sequence at create time.

get.summary: Get the policy specification for a product
Get the policy number format for a product
Get a commission setup by id

404.description: Product or commission setup not found
Product or commission setup not found
Product or commission setup not found

get.summary: Get the claim notification timeline for a product
Get password policy (tenant singleton; returns V3 defaults if never configured)
Get nature of loss by id
Get the customer number format (tenant singleton)
get.description: Returns 404 if no format is configured — customer onboarding will fail with CUSTOMER_NUMBER_FORMAT_NOT_CONFIGURED until this is set.

get.summary: Get class of business by id
Get cause of loss by id

get.description: Returns the current alert thresholds and retention policy for this tenant.

put.description: Updates alert thresholds (failed logins, bulk deletes, large approval amount, business hours) and retention period. Requires SETUP_UPDATE role (System Admin only).

get.summary: List all access policies (System Admin only)

put.summary: Upsert a category- or report-level access policy

get.description: Returns the quote header, risk items (with per-item loadings + discounts), quote-level loadings/discounts, selected clauses, and the full premium breakdown.

put.description: Each update increments the quote's version number — version history is preserved on the QuoteDetailPage timeline. Submission locks the quote from this endpoint.

get.description: Returns the full policy including risks, coinsurance participants, premium breakdown, document state, NAICOM UID, NIID reference.

put.description: Allows updates to the policy header (dates, premium, payment terms) while the policy is in DRAFT. Submission locks the policy from this endpoint.

put.summary: Update a single risk on the policy schedule
put.description: Only allowed while policy is DRAFT. Updates description, sum insured, rate, motor reg no (for motor classes), or any product-specific fields.

delete.summary: Remove a risk from the schedule
delete.description: Hard-deletes the risk row. Only allowed while policy is DRAFT — the risk schedule is locked at submission.

put.description: Sets the full list of coinsurance participants on the policy. Participant shares must sum to 100%. Only valid for Direct-with-Coinsurance and Inward-Coinsurance business types. Policy must be DRAFT.

400.description: Shares do not sum to 100%, or business type does not support coinsurance

get.description: Returns the full customer including KYC status, decrypted PII (id_number, address), directors (for corporate), and channel (Direct or broker).

put.summary: Update customer (KYC re-trigger if KYC fields change)
put.description: Multipart with optional idDocument + per-director documents keyed as directorDoc_{index}. Updating any KYC field requires a reason (audit-logged twice: general UPDATE + dedicated CustomerKyc UPDATE with the reason). Corporate customers must keep at least 2 active directors at all times.

400.description: Validation error, KYC reason missing, or would drop director count below 2

post.summary: Create a model under a make

post.description: Creates the user in Keycloak with the configured access group attribute, then triggers Keycloak's UPDATE_PASSWORD + VERIFY_EMAIL action emails. The user sets their password on first sign-in.
Triggers Keycloak's UPDATE_PASSWORD action email. The user sets a new password via the emailed link. No temporary password is generated; nothing leaves the realm.

get.summary: List survey thresholds for a product
List commission setups for a product
List required-doc rules for a product

get.description: Filter by treaty type, status, and/or treaty year. Returns treaty headers with participants embedded.

post.description: Treaty-type-specific fields are validated by the service: Surplus requires retention + surplus capacity; QS requires per-participant shares summing to 100%; XOL requires per-risk retention + limit.

400.description: Validation error (mismatched type fields, dates inverted, etc.)

post.summary: Add a reinsurance company as a treaty participant
post.description: Surplus treaty: participant gets a surplus_line slot. QS: participant gets a share percentage. Setting isLead=true designates this participant as the lead reinsurer (exactly one per treaty).

404.description: Treaty or reinsurance company not found

400.description: Share would exceed 100%, surplus line conflict, or duplicate lead

post.description: Transitions ACTIVE → EXPIRED. Used at end of treaty year. Allocations already made under this treaty remain valid (treaties protect by inception date, not by current status).
Transitions to CANCELLED from any non-terminal state. Stronger than expire — used when terminating the treaty mid-year due to commercial breakdown or insurer downgrade.
Transitions DRAFT → ACTIVE. Validates the participant list (QS shares sum to 100%, lead reinsurer present, etc.). Active treaties become eligible for automatic RI allocation on new policies.

400.description: Participants invalid (shares mismatch, no lead, etc.)

get.description: Filter by policyId, status, and/or reinsuranceCompanyId. Used by the FAC dashboard to show outstanding offer slips per reinsurer.

post.description: Generates an offer slip reference (facReference) and DRAFT-state cover. The offer slip PDF is generated by cia-documents and sent to the reinsurer. Confirmation comes later via /confirm.

400.description: Validation error (negative premium, dates inverted, reinsurer inactive)

404.description: Policy or reinsurance company not found

post.description: Transitions DRAFT → CONFIRMED. Fires FAC_PREMIUM_CEDED event → SubledgerPostingService cascades a CreditNote (payable to the reinsurer for ceded premium net of commission) + JE. Period-lock check applies.

409.description: FAC cover not in DRAFT state

post.description: Cancels with a mandatory reason. For CONFIRMED covers, reverses the cascaded credit note + JE (reversal carve-out applies — can cross a closed period).

409.description: FAC cover already in terminal state

get.description: Filter by policyId and/or status. Each allocation row embeds the per-participant lines.

post.summary: Allocate a policy against a treaty
post.description: Runs the treaty-type-specific allocation: Surplus / QS / XOL. Computes retained vs ceded amounts, per-participant lines, and commission. Status starts at AUTO_ALLOCATED for treaty-bound allocations. Endorsements that change SI trigger proportional reallocation.

400.description: Validation error — policy not eligible, treaty inactive, or SI exceeds gross capacity

post.description: Required for allocations on policies exceeding gross capacity. Transitions AUTO_ALLOCATED → CONFIRMED. Reinsurance officer reviews the allocation lines before finance impact.
Used when the underlying policy is cancelled or the allocation needs to be re-run (e.g. batch reallocation under a new treaty). Reverses any cascaded credit notes from this allocation.

post.summary: Run a report — returns JSON result
Run a report — returns PDF download
Run a report — streams CSV download
Pin a report for the current user

delete.summary: Unpin a report for the current user

post.summary: Clone a SYSTEM report into a CUSTOM report

post.description: Creates a DRAFT quote. Single-risk: one risk item. Multi-risk: multiple risk items with per-item loadings/discounts. Premium is computed live by the service per the tenant's quote_config (LOADING_FIRST | DISCOUNT_FIRST sequence).

400.description: Validation error (customer blacklisted, product inactive, etc.)

post.description: Transitions DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL. Starts the QuoteApprovalWorkflow Temporal workflow with multi-level escalation against the configured approval tiers.
Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → DRAFT with rejection notes — underwriter can edit and re-submit.

Deep-copies an existing quote into a new DRAFT — new quote_number, fresh expires_at, cleared approval/rejection metadata, current user as inputter. Risks, coinsurance participants, quote-level loadings/discounts and selected clauses are carried forward. Totals are re-computed against the current QuoteConfig.
Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED. Approved quotes are eligible for /policies/bind-from-quote (Module 3).

403.description: Forbidden — caller lacks QUOTATION_APPROVE or amount exceeds approver tier

get.description: Filter by status and/or customerId; both omitted returns all. Returns lightweight summary projection (no risks or coinsurance participants).

post.summary: Create a policy directly (without a quote)
post.description: Used for renewals, broker-relationship-only business, or any path where a formal quote was never issued. Policy starts in DRAFT; submission + approval are separate steps.
Transitions ASSIGNED → REPORT_SUBMITTED. Captures findings, recommended sum-insured cap, and risk-mitigation notes.
Manager-level override (UNDERWRITING_APPROVE) that bypasses the normal survey approval flow. Records overrideReason for audit. Allowed from any non-terminal survey state.
Creates the survey record (state ASSIGNED). Idempotent re-assignment supported. Triggers an email notification to the surveyor.
Transitions REPORT_SUBMITTED → APPROVED. Required before policy submission if the product configures survey-mandatory.
Transitions DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL. Validates the risk schedule (at least one risk), survey requirements (if any), and premium. Starts the PolicyApprovalWorkflow Temporal workflow.

post.summary: Add multiple risks at once (bulk insert)
post.description: Used by the bulk-upload flow on the policy detail page. All-or-nothing — any validation failure rolls back the batch. Policy must be DRAFT.
Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → DRAFT with rejection notes — underwriter can edit and re-submit. No GL impact.
Reverses a cancellation: CANCELLED → ACTIVE. Reverses the credit-note endorsement issued at cancellation. Requires UNDERWRITING_APPROVE since it materially restores cover.

409.description: Policy not CANCELLED, or cover dates expired

post.description: Same shape as NAICOM upload, but for motor + marine policies that need NIID registration. NIID reference is patched onto the policy when accepted.

409.description: Policy not eligible (not motor/marine, or NIID already received)

post.description: Starts a NaicomUploadWorkflow OR signals an existing one. Used when the post-approval automatic upload failed and the underwriter wants to retry on-demand. NAICOM UID is patched onto the policy when accepted (was PENDING).

409.description: Policy not ACTIVE, or NAICOM UID already received

post.summary: Email the policy document to the insured
post.description: Triggers the email-delivery activity in PolicyApprovalWorkflow on-demand. Marks documentSentAt on the policy. Allowed for ACTIVE policies whose document has been generated.

409.description: Policy not ACTIVE, or document not yet generated

post.summary: Record that the insured acknowledged the policy document
post.description: Sets documentAcknowledgedAt on the policy. Used by the back-office to record a phone/email confirmation when the customer has not used the self-serve acknowledge link.
Transitions ACTIVE → CANCELLED with mandatory reason. Issues a credit-note endorsement for the unearned premium pro-rata. If the policy has claims, those remain on the original cover period.

Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → ACTIVE. Fires POLICY_APPROVED event → SubledgerPostingService cascade (DebitNote + JE for the gross premium). Kicks off NAICOM upload child workflow (and NIID if motor/marine). Period-lock check applies.

403.description: Forbidden — caller lacks UNDERWRITING_APPROVE or amount exceeds approver tier

post.summary: Bind a policy from an approved quote
post.description: Creates a new policy in DRAFT state populated from an approved quote (customer, product, dates, risks, premium). The quote is marked CONVERTED. The policy still requires submission + approval before becoming ACTIVE.

409.description: Quote already converted to a policy

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates the partner record. Keycloak client creation is handled separately.

Flips a period to SOFT_CLOSED and opens the 5-business-day grace window. Reads + reversals continue to flow; new writes require FINANCE_OVERRIDE_LOCK. Idempotent — repeated soft-close on an already SOFT_CLOSED period returns the existing active lock.

Releases the active SOFT or HARD lock. Publishes PeriodReopenedEvent → CFO email notification (recipients from cia.finance.period-reopen-recipients property). Requires FINANCE_REOPEN_PERIOD role (segregation of duties — distinct from FINANCE_APPROVE that closes).

404.description: Period not found, or no active lock

post.description: Flips a period to HARD_CLOSED. If the period is still OPEN, auto-soft-closes first to satisfy the V31 ck_fiscal_period_close_chronology check constraint. After HARD close, ALL writes (including reversals) are blocked except via FINANCE_REOPEN_PERIOD reopen. Idempotent.

Idempotent orchestrator: invokes LrcEngine + LicEngine in sequence (skipping any that already ran for the period), then computes the §83/§84 Insurance Service Result. Use the more granular engine endpoints if you need to re-run a single stage.

post.summary: Run the onerous contract test for a period
post.description: Tests every paa_lrc row in the period; posts JE for net loss-component movement per group. Idempotent (delta-based — no movement → no-op).

post.summary: Recognise LRC for a fiscal period
post.description: Runs the LRC engine across every IFRS 17 group for the period. Idempotent at (group, period) — fails with 409 LrcRecognitionAlreadyDoneException if any group has already been recognised. Posts JEs via the Slice 1.4 gateway; period-lock interceptor applies (423 if locked).

200.description: LRC recognised for all groups in period

409.description: LrcRecognitionAlreadyDoneException — at least one group already recognised

post.summary: Recognise LIC for a fiscal period
post.description: Runs the LIC engine across every IFRS 17 group for the period. Idempotent at (group, period) — fails with 409 LicRecognitionAlreadyDoneException if any group has already been recognised. Disclosure-only in v1 (no JE).

post.summary: Recognise discount unwind for a period
post.description: Computes unwind for every paa_lic row in the period, posts JE, updates paa_lic.discount_unwind_to_date. Idempotent via the JE-gateway triple. Routes to P&L or OCI per tenant election in paa_config.

Marks the submission as sent to NAICOM. After this the payload is frozen (re-generation rejected with 409 PayloadFrozenException). The reason field is optional and lands in naicom_submission_event.reason.

409.description: IllegalSubmissionStateException — only DRAFT can transition to SUBMITTED

post.description: Soft-deletes the row to vacate the (submission_type, period_id) UNIQUE slot, allowing a fresh corrected submission. The retracted row survives as soft-deleted audit evidence. Reason is mandatory.

409.description: IllegalSubmissionStateException — only SUBMITTED can transition to RETRACTED

post.summary: Render an artifact in the requested format (JSON | CSV | PDF)
post.description: Renders the submission payload to bytes via JsonArtifactRenderer / CsvArtifactRenderer / PdfArtifactRenderer; stores via DocumentStorageService; records SHA-256 hash for tamper evidence. Replaces any existing live artifact for the same (submission, format) — the prior row is soft-deleted (V41 uq_naicom_submission_artifact_format).
Terminal state. Indicates the submission and its NAICOM acknowledgement have been moved to long-term audit retention.

409.description: IllegalSubmissionStateException — only ACKNOWLEDGED can transition to ARCHIVED

post.description: Records that NAICOM acknowledged the submission. Requires the naicomUid returned by the regulator.

409.description: IllegalSubmissionStateException — only SUBMITTED can transition to ACKNOWLEDGED

post.description: Computes the payload for the given (submissionType, periodId) via the registered NaicomSubmissionEngine. Idempotent under (submissionType, period_id, tenant_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. Re-running for an existing DRAFT row updates the payload in place; once SUBMITTED, the payload is frozen and re-generation throws PayloadFrozenException (409). Period must be HARD_CLOSED (422 PeriodNotHardClosedException otherwise).

409.description: PayloadFrozenException — SUBMITTED row cannot be re-generated

get.description: All filters optional. Filtering by accountCode or classOfBusinessId joins to journal_entry_line — a JE with N matching lines still appears once in the result (DISTINCT). Lines are NOT included in the summary; drill into GET /{id} for the line array. The Slice 1.10 classOfBusinessId substrate is filterable here.

post.description: Manual JE post for adjustments that do not originate from a subledger event. Validates double-entry balance (sum debits == sum credits per currency), checks against period locks (HTTP 423 LOCKED if rejected), and applies the (source_module, source_event_type, source_reference) UNIQUE constraint for idempotency.

400.description: Unbalanced lines, invalid account, or missing required fields

post.description: Posts a mirror JE (debits ↔ credits) and flips the original to REVERSED. The reversal carve-out in LockableByPeriod.isReversal() means reversals CAN cross a closed period — corrections to closed periods remain possible. Requires the elevated FINANCE_APPROVE role.

409.description: Already reversed, or status not POSTED

post.description: Slice 1.7c. Posts a restatement JE that legitimately crosses a closed period to correct an error or accounting policy change. Gated by FINANCE_APPROVE_PPA (distinct from FINANCE_CREATE) to enforce segregation of duties — the officer who booked the original cannot approve its restatement. Notifies recipients via PeriodReopenedEvent.

422.description: Target period not eligible for PPA

post.description: Accepts an admin-supplied provision matrix for one period, computes lifetime ECL = Σ(outstanding × default_rate), and posts the JE for the movement versus cumulative prior ECL. Idempotent at (period, ECL_PROVISION_MATRIX) — re-runs with the same matrix produce a no-op delta.

get.description: Returns every non-soft-deleted holding, ordered by security name.

post.description: Runs §4.1 classification automatically based on business_model + SPPI flag in the request, then persists the holding. The chosen classification governs downstream JE routing (FVPL → P&L, FVOCI → OCI, AC → asset).
Apply a §B4.1.26 reclassification (business model change). Rare event — appends a row to investment_classification_history (Type-2 SCD); a CHECK constraint rejects no-op rows.

400.description: Validation error or attempted no-op reclassification

post.description: Accepts an admin-supplied list of (holdingId, fairValue) pairs for one period and posts the appropriate JEs by classification. Idempotent — re-runs that find closing_fair_value already set on a holding's carrying-value row skip silently.

409.description: UnsupportedFairValueOperationException — AC holding cannot be remeasured to fair value

post.description: Accepts an admin-supplied batch of target ECL amounts + optional stage transitions for one period. Posts JEs for the delta vs cumulative prior ECL. Routing depends on holding classification (AC vs FVOCI_DEBT).

409.description: Unsupported ECL on FVPL holding (FVPL has no ECL — impairment IS the fair-value movement)

post.summary: Recognise interest accrual for a period
post.description: Runs the engine across every AC + FVOCI_DEBT holding for the period. Idempotent at (holding, period) — fails with 409 AmortisedCostAlreadyDoneException if any holding has already been recognised.

get.summary: List all fiscal years (no period embedding)

post.summary: Create a fiscal year + auto-generate periods
post.description: Creates the fiscal year in DRAFT state and synchronously generates all 19 MONTH / QUARTER / HALF_YEAR / YEAR periods. Activation is a separate step.

409.description: Fiscal year with overlapping start/end dates already exists

400.description: Validation error (overlapping dates, invalid name, etc.)

post.description: Final state. Year-end close cascades hard-close to all child periods that are still OPEN.

409.description: Year is already CLOSED, or not ACTIVE

post.description: Demotes any currently ACTIVE fiscal year to CLOSED and activates this one. There is always exactly one ACTIVE fiscal year per tenant.

get.description: Filter by policyId, status, and/or customerId. Each endorsement embeds its risk schedule. Used by the Debit Note Analysis Report (Module 4 feature).

post.description: Creates the endorsement in DRAFT. Type-specific validation: period changes require new dates, SI changes require newSumInsured, add/delete items require itemDescription. Pro-rata premium adjustment is computed by service.

400.description: Validation error or type-specific fields missing

post.description: Transitions DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL. Starts the EndorsementApprovalWorkflow Temporal workflow.
Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → DRAFT with rejection reason — underwriter can edit and re-submit. No GL impact.
For DRAFT endorsements: hard-cancel (no GL impact). For APPROVED endorsements: reverses the cascaded debit/credit note + JE (reversal carve-out applies — can cross closed periods).

Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED. Fires ENDORSEMENT_APPROVED event → SubledgerPostingService cascades a DebitNote (positive adjustment) or CreditNote (negative adjustment) + JE. For Increase SI or Add Items types, RI allocation re-runs proportionally. Period-lock check applies.

403.description: Forbidden — caller lacks UNDERWRITING_APPROVE or amount exceeds approver tier

post.description: Multipart upload. templateType is mandatory (POLICY / QUOTE / ENDORSEMENT / DV). Optional scope via productId and/or classOfBusinessId — null = global default template for the type. File is stored via DocumentStorageService.

VOID is a stronger terminal state than CANCELLED — used when the underlying business event itself was reversed (policy rejection after approval, etc.). Cascades a contra JE via SubledgerPostingService.
Transitions the DN to CANCELLED. Allowed only when no receipts have been posted (paidAmount = 0). Rejected with 409 otherwise; reverse the receipts first.

409.description: Cannot cancel — receipts exist or DN already in terminal state

get.summary: List receipts for a debit note (paginated)

post.summary: Post a new receipt against the debit note
post.description: Generates a receipt number, subtracts from DN outstanding, posts the JE via SubledgerPostingService (Receipt event), and flips DN status to SETTLED when paidAmount == totalAmount.

400.description: Validation error or amount exceeds outstanding

post.description: Marks the receipt REVERSED with a reason. Re-opens the parent DN's outstanding amount and posts a contra JE. Reversal carve-out applies — can cross a closed period.

Manually re-runs KYC against the current ID details. Used when KYC provider returned a transient failure, or after the provider's data refresh window. Updates kyc_status accordingly and audit-logs the result.
Flags the customer as BLACKLISTED with a mandatory reason. Existing policies remain active but quote/policy creation against this customer is rejected. Audit-logged.

delete.description: Restores the customer to normal status. Audit-logged; the blacklist history survives for audit even after removal.

get.summary: List documents attached to a customer

post.summary: Attach a document to the customer
post.description: Document is uploaded separately via /storage; this endpoint records the metadata + storage reference.

400.description: Validation error or storage reference invalid

post.description: Multipart request. Generates a customer number via CustomerNumberFormatService (requires per-tenant format configured — 400 CUSTOMER_NUMBER_FORMAT_NOT_CONFIGURED otherwise). Calls KycVerificationService synchronously for individual KYC (NIN / Voter's Card / DL / Passport).

201.description: Customer created (KYC status may be VERIFIED or FAILED)

400.description: Validation error or customer number format not configured

post.description: Multipart request — RC number + CAC certificate + at least 2 directors (enforced by MINIMUM_DIRECTORS_REQUIRED rule). KYC validates company name against RC number; each director's KYC runs against their ID.

400.description: Validation error, fewer than 2 directors, or RC number conflict

post.description: Transitions the CN to CANCELLED. Allowed only when no payments have been posted (paidAmount = 0). Reverse the payments first if cancellation is needed after payment.

409.description: Cannot cancel — payments exist or CN already in terminal state

get.summary: List payments for a credit note (paginated)

post.summary: Post a new payment against the credit note
post.description: Generates a payment number, subtracts from CN outstanding, posts the JE via SubledgerPostingService (Payment event), and flips CN status to SETTLED when paidAmount == totalAmount.

400.description: Validation error or amount exceeds outstanding

post.description: Marks the payment REVERSED with a reason. Re-opens the parent CN's outstanding amount and posts a contra JE. Reversal carve-out applies — can cross a closed period.

get.description: Filter by any combination of policyId, status, customerId. Returns claim summaries (no nested reserves/expenses/documents).

post.description: Creates a claim against a policy in REGISTERED state. Validates: policy is ACTIVE, incident date falls within cover period, nature/cause of loss are valid for the product. Initial reserveAmount may be set later via /reserve.

400.description: Validation error (policy inactive, date outside cover, etc.)

post.description: Marks the claim WITHDRAWN with a reason — used when the policyholder decides not to pursue the claim. Allowed in pre-approval states only.
Transitions REGISTERED/PROCESSING → PENDING_APPROVAL. Validates required documents are uploaded (per product's claim_document_requirements). Starts the ClaimApprovalWorkflow Temporal workflow.

409.description: Claim not in a submittable state

post.description: Final state. Fires CLAIM_SETTLED event → final GL reconciliation. Typically called after the cascaded payment has cleared in Finance.

409.description: Claim not APPROVED or DV not executed

post.description: Sets a new reserve amount. The previous amount is preserved as a ClaimReserve history row (audit-grade), with a mandatory reason. Used by IFRS 17 PAA LIC engine to roll forward LIC totals.

409.description: Cannot adjust reserve on SETTLED claim

post.description: Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → REJECTED with a mandatory reason. Reason surfaces on the claim detail and in customer notifications. No GL impact.

409.description: Claim not in a rejectable state

post.description: Transitions ASSIGNED → REPORT_SUBMITTED. Captures the inspector's findings, recommended loss amount, and signature. The next steps are approval/decline/override.
Manager-level override (CLAIMS_APPROVE) that bypasses normal approve/decline flow. Records overrideReason for audit. Allowed from any non-terminal inspection state.
Transitions REPORT_SUBMITTED → DECLINED with a mandatory reason. Sends the inspection back for re-work; new report can be submitted.
Creates the inspection record (state: ASSIGNED) and assigns an internal or external inspector. Triggers an email notification to the inspector. Idempotent re-assignment supported.
Transitions REPORT_SUBMITTED → APPROVED. Optionally records reviewer notes. Required before claim approval if the product configures inspection-mandatory.

Renders the DV PDF (own-damage / third-party / ex-gratia type) using the configured template and the approved amount. Stores the artifact via DocumentStorageService and updates dvType + dvDocumentPath on the claim. Allowed after APPROVED.

409.description: Claim not APPROVED — DV cannot be generated

400.description: DV type missing or invalid amount

post.description: Records that the customer has signed/accepted the DV (sets dvExecutedAt). Settlement (/settle) is allowed after this; the cascaded payment can then be processed in Finance.

409.description: DV not yet generated, or already executed

post.summary: Assign a surveyor to the claim
post.description: Surveyor must be active in setup → surveyors. Triggers an email notification to the surveyor. Independent of the inspection workflow under /inspection.

Transitions PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED. Fires CLAIM_APPROVED event → SubledgerPostingService cascade (CreditNote + JE for the approved amount). Required before DV generation. Period-lock check applies.
Vendor info is mandatory. Status starts at PENDING; approval is a separate step.
Allowed only on PENDING expenses (no GL impact yet). For approved expenses that need to be undone, reverse the cascaded payment first.

409.description: Cannot cancel APPROVED expense — reverse the payment first

post.description: Flips status to APPROVED and fires CLAIM_EXPENSE_APPROVED event → SubledgerPostingService cascades a CreditNote (payable) + posts the JE. Triggers period-lock check via the interceptor.

get.summary: List documents attached to a claim
get.description: Optionally filter by documentType. Returns metadata only — use /{id}/content to stream bytes.

post.description: Multipart upload. The file is persisted via DocumentStorageService; metadata is recorded with the supplied documentType. Required-documents checklist re-evaluates on each upload.

400.description: File too large, MIME type not allowed, or documentType missing

get.summary: List comments on a claim (paginated, chronological)

post.summary: Add a comment to a claim
post.description: Append-only — author is resolved from Authentication.getName(); body captured verbatim. There is no edit/delete endpoint by design.
Called by the frontend after successful Keycloak authentication. Requires a valid JWT.
Called by the frontend on logout. Requires a valid JWT.
Public endpoint — no JWT required. Called when JWT validation fails for a known user. Triggers failed-login alert detection.
Marks the alert as acknowledged. The acknowledging user is recorded.

post.summary: Start a retroactive JE backfill workflow
post.description: Kicks off a Temporal workflow that sweeps source tables (policies / claims / claim_expenses / endorsements / ri_fac_covers) and posts the missing JEs. Pre-flight check rejects the run if any target period is HARD_CLOSED or past its SOFT grace. PLATFORM_ADMIN role only — intentionally out of reach of normal finance day-to-day work.

400.description: Invalid backfill scope (event types, date range, etc.)

patch.summary: Enable or disable a partner app

get.description: Returns the full claim including current reserve, approved amount, DV state, surveyor assignment, and rejection/withdrawal context.

patch.description: Partial update of nature/cause of loss, contact details, description, estimated loss. Only allowed while status is REGISTERED or PROCESSING.

409.description: Claim in terminal state — cannot edit

get.summary: List RMs assigned to a branch
get.description: Used by the customer + policy create forms to scope the RM selector to the chosen branch.

get.summary: List causes under a nature of loss
get.description: Used by the claim registration form to scope causes after the user selects a nature.

get.summary: List approval groups for a given entity type
get.description: Used by the approval workflows to find the tier list for the current transaction type (QUOTE / POLICY / ENDORSEMENT / CLAIM / FINANCE_RECEIPT / FINANCE_PAYMENT).
Returns the treaty header plus all active participants (soft-deleted participants excluded).

get.summary: List pinned reports for the current user

get.description: Generates the quote PDF on-demand via QuotePdfService (PDFBox + the configured tenant template). Includes the premium breakdown, validity period from quote_config, inputter + approver signatures (when APPROVED). Allowed in APPROVED + CONVERTED states.

409.description: Quote not in APPROVED or CONVERTED state

get.description: Matches against quote number, customer name, product name. Case-insensitive substring search.
Returns survey state — surveyor assignment, submitted report, approve/override outcome. Returns 404 if no survey has been initiated (some products do not require one).

404.description: No survey exists for this policy

get.description: Streams the policy PDF rendered by cia-documents at approval time. Includes the embedded NAICOM certificate, clause bank, and signatures.

404.description: Policy or its document not found

get.description: Matches against policy number, customer name, product name. Case-insensitive substring search.

get.summary: Get the trial balance as of a business date
get.description: Returns a flat per-account list with a footer summary. The asOf parameter is interpreted as a business date (economic date) per the Slice 1.4 D4 decision. Includes Income + Expense accounts (not just balance-sheet accounts) so cumulative P&L can be computed.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Business date (YYYY-MM-DD). Treated as inclusive — JEs with business_date <= asOf are aggregated.

get.description: Returns every non-soft-deleted rule, sorted ascending by source_event_type. Each row carries the Dr/Cr account codes plus their human-readable names resolved through the Chart of Accounts.

get.summary: Get the full lock history of a period
get.description: Returns every soft/hard/release event for the period in chronological order. The period_lock table is a Type-2 SCD — released_at IS NULL identifies the current active lock; older rows are the audit trail.

get.summary: Bulk-preview lock state across a date range
get.description: Returns one LockReportEntry per business date in [from, to]. Used by Slice 1.8 backfill and Module 8 bulk receipts to pre-flight a range before kicking off the workflow — surfaces locks BEFORE the per-row write fails rather than discovering them on row 4,837.

400.description: Date range invalid (from > to or missing)

200.description: One entry per business date in range

get.description: Every portfolio (active + inactive) sorted by code ASC. Soft-deleted rows excluded.

get.summary: Get §103 movement analysis for a period
get.description: Returns the §103-shaped roll-forward: opening balances + period movements (premiums earned, claims incurred, finance income/expense, OCI elements) + closing balances. Computed from the V38 paa_movement_analysis view.
Read-only — recomputes the §83 (insurance revenue) / §84 (insurance service expense) breakdown from the current paa_lrc + paa_lic state. No engine invocation.
All four filters are optional. Default ordering: cohort year DESC, portfolio code ASC, onerousness ASC (most recent cohort first; onerous groups at the bottom of each (portfolio, cohort) pair).

get.summary: List submissions filtered by period and/or state
get.description: At least one of (periodId, state) must be supplied — both omitted is rejected to avoid a full-table scan. When both are supplied, results are the intersection. Returns summary projections (payload omitted).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by submission state (DRAFT | SUBMITTED | ACKNOWLEDGED | ARCHIVED | RETRACTED)

get.summary: Get a submission with its payload
get.description: Returns the full submission including the rendered payload (engine output).

get.summary: List state-transition events for a submission
get.description: Returns the append-only Type-2 SCD history of state transitions on this submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED, RETRACTED, etc.). The row sequence IS the audit history; there is no separate history table.
Returns metadata for every live and soft-deleted artifact ever rendered for this submission. Bytes are NOT streamed by this endpoint — use the download endpoint for that.
Streams the artifact bytes via DocumentStorageService. Returns 404 if no LIVE artifact exists for the (submission, format) pair — soft-deleted artifacts are not downloadable.

404.description: ArtifactNotFoundException — no live artifact for this (submission, format)

200.description: Artifact bytes streamed (Content-Type set per format)

get.summary: Get a journal entry by id
get.description: Returns the JE header plus its lines. JE narratives sometimes embed disclosure substrate (e.g. premium-receivable ECL provision matrix for §B5.5.36 evidence) — see /finance/ifrs9/premium-receivable-ecl docs.

get.summary: Get §B5.5.39 movement analysis for a period
get.description: Returns two sections: investments (from V40 view, aggregated by holding + classification totals) and premium-receivable ECL (derived from JE aggregate on account 1340 by business_date — opening = sum prior periods, closing = sum through period-end, movement = closing − opening).

get.summary: Get classification history of a holding (§B4.1.26)
get.description: Returns every Type-2 SCD row from investment_classification_history for the holding, ordered ASC by reclassification date. NAICOM auditors require this trail per §B4.1.26 — previous → new classification, the reclassification date, the textual reason, and the approver.

get.summary: Get a fiscal year by id
get.description: Set includePeriods=true to embed the period tree (MONTH → QUARTER → HALF_YEAR → YEAR) inline.

delete.description: Sets deleted_at. Rejected with 409 if any journal entry references one of this year's periods — historical GL data cannot be orphaned.

409.description: Cannot delete — journal entries reference this year's periods

get.summary: List periods under a fiscal year
get.description: Returns every MONTH / QUARTER / HALF_YEAR / YEAR period that belongs to this fiscal year (19 rows total, generated eagerly at fiscal-year create).

get.summary: Get the currently ACTIVE fiscal year
get.description: Exactly one fiscal year is ACTIVE per tenant. Returns 404 if no year has been activated yet (initial tenant setup).

404.description: No fiscal year is currently ACTIVE

get.summary: Get the Chart of Accounts as a nested tree
get.description: Returns the COA rooted at the five top-level account-type classes (ASSET / LIABILITY / EQUITY / INCOME / EXPENSE), with children sorted ascending by code. Soft-deleted rows are omitted.

Computes what the premium adjustment WOULD be for a given policy + effective date + new net premium, without creating the endorsement. Returns the type classification (ADDITIONAL_PREMIUM / RETURN_PREMIUM / NON_PREMIUM_BEARING) based on sign of the adjustment. Used by the CreateEndorsementSheet live-preview.

delete.description: Historical documents generated with this template remain unaffected — they are stored as rendered bytes via DocumentStorageService.

get.description: Filter by status, customerId, or entityId (the underlying policy / endorsement). All omitted returns all. Outstanding amount is computed inline (totalAmount − paidAmount).

get.summary: Global search across policies, claims, customers, and quotes
Policies expiring in the next 7 days, grouped by day
Last 10 audit log entries across all modules
Pending approval counts by entity type

get.description: Filter by customer type (INDIVIDUAL / CORPORATE) and/or KYC status (PENDING / VERIFIED / FAILED). Returns lightweight summary projection.
Matches against customer number, first/last name (individual), company name (corporate), email, phone. Encrypted PII fields (id_number, address) are NOT searched — they live behind pgcrypto.
Filter by status or entityId (the underlying claim / FAC / commission record). Outstanding amount is computed inline (totalAmount − paidAmount).

get.summary: List reserve history for the claim
get.description: Returns every reserve adjustment with previous amount, new amount, reason, author, timestamp. The reserve table is append-only (history is the audit trail).

get.summary: Get required-documents checklist for the claim
get.description: Derives the checklist at request time from the product's claim_document_requirements setup joined with currently-uploaded claim_documents. Used by the UI's missing-docs badge and by /submit's pre-flight validation.
Returns the single inspection state for the claim — inspector assignment, submitted report, approve/decline/override outcome. Returns 404 if no inspection has been initiated.

404.description: No inspection exists for this claim

get.summary: Download inspection-report documents as a zip
get.description: Zips every SURVEY_REPORT document on the claim and streams the archive. Underlying docs live in DocumentStorageService; the zip is composed in memory (claim-doc volumes are small in practice).

delete.description: Soft-deletes the metadata row and removes the underlying object from storage. Required-documents checklist re-evaluates after deletion.

get.description: Returns the raw file (PDF / image / etc) with Content-Disposition: attachment so browsers offer a download.
Matches against claim number, customer name, policy number, nature of loss. Case-insensitive substring search.
Ranked list of users by total action count in a date range.
Login, logout, and failed authentication events in a date range.
Full before/after change history for a specific entity.
All APPROVE and REJECT events across every module in a date range.
All audit events performed by a specific user in a date range.
All audit events for a specific entity type (module) in a date range.
Paginated, filterable audit trail. Filter by entityType, entityId, userId, action, or date range.

403.description: Insufficient role — requires AUDIT_VIEW or SETUP_UPDATE

get.description: Filterable by userId or date range. Requires AUDIT_VIEW or SETUP_UPDATE role.

Streams a CSV file containing audit log entries matching the supplied filters. All filters are optional; omitting them exports the full audit log. Response includes `Content-Disposition: attachment` header.
Returns all alerts or unacknowledged-only when `unacknowledgedOnly=true`. Ordered newest first.
Returns current state of the named workflow: RUNNING / COMPLETED / FAILED, per-event-type counters (posted / skipped-dup / failed), and the resulting JE-id manifest once complete.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the participant. Historical allocation lines that reference this participant are preserved (audit trail). Allowed in DRAFT or ACTIVE state.

409.description: Cannot remove lead participant — promote another lead first

delete.description: Soft-deletes the metadata row and removes the object from storage. Audit-logged.

get.description: Flat paginated list of receipts across all debit notes. The existing nested GET /api/v1/debit-notes/{dnId}/receipts stays as the per-DN canonical surface; this is the cross-parent operator visibility surface added in F7 slice α. Sorted by created_at DESC. Soft-deleted rows always excluded. Requires FINANCE_VIEW.

parameters.name: debitNoteId
parameters.description: Return only receipts against this debit note

get.description: Flat paginated list of payments across all credit notes. The existing nested GET /api/v1/credit-notes/{cnId}/payments stays as the per-CN canonical surface; this is the cross-parent operator visibility surface added in F7 slice α. Sorted by created_at DESC. Soft-deleted rows always excluded. Requires FINANCE_VIEW.

parameters.name: creditNoteId
parameters.description: Return only payments against this credit note

get.description: Streams the generated OFFICIAL RECEIPT PDF for the given receipt from object storage. 404 when pdfPath IS NULL (PDF was never generated or generation failed) or when the receipt id is unknown. Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="REC-<receiptNumber>.pdf".

404.description: Receipt not found OR pdfPath is null

get.description: Streams the generated PAYMENT VOUCHER PDF (label varies by source: CLAIM SETTLEMENT VOUCHER / COMMISSION VOUCHER / FAC PREMIUM VOUCHER / ENDORSEMENT REFUND VOUCHER) from object storage. 404 when pdfPath IS NULL or payment id unknown. Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="PAY-<paymentNumber>.pdf".

404.description: Payment not found OR pdfPath is null

ReceiptListItemResponse.description: Projection row for GET /api/v1/receipts. Carries DN + policy + customer context so the table row does not need to separately fetch each parent. Reversal columns populated when status == REVERSED.

policyNumber.description: Null when the DN is not policy-backed

pdfPath.description: MinIO object path of the generated PDF (e.g. "receipts/2026/05/<uuid>.pdf"). Null = PDF was never generated (generator failure logs WARN + leaves the column null).

PaymentListItemResponse.description: Projection row for GET /api/v1/payments. Carries CN + beneficiary context for the flat-list UI. beneficiaryType/beneficiaryReference resolved from CreditNote.entityType / entityReference at creation (no Policy/Customer chain traversal).

beneficiaryType.description: FinanceEntityType enum stringified — CLAIM | COMMISSION | REINSURANCE | ENDORSEMENT | POLICY | CLAIM_EXPENSE

pdfPath.description: MinIO object path of the generated PDF (e.g. "receipts/2026/05/<uuid>.pdf"). Null = PDF was never generated (generator failure logs WARN + leaves the column null).

bearer-jwt.description: Keycloak JWT — obtain via Keycloak login
